description: This file defines the EmployeeAddress class, representing an employee's address details within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties such as street, city, province, zipcode, and country, and provides a method to output the address as a string. The class uses traits and interacts with the Country entity via ORM.

classes.name: EmployeeAddress
classes.description: Represents an employee's address information, capable of converting itself to a string for display purposes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeAddress object with address details such as street, city, province, zipcode, and country.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Generates a string representation of the address, including country name if present.
